# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.name }} does not publish original research. Each edition selects open work, assesses it in fixed terms, and gives each selection a permanent address (edition and well, for example "{{ site.name }} 0 · F7").

Rating terms. Importance: Useful, Notable, Major, Landmark. Strength of evidence: Contested, Preliminary, Suggestive, Solid, Compelling, Not applicable. Independence: Self-reported by developer, Independent, Peer-reviewed. Each assessment also records what was checked, conflicts of interest, and whether an editor has reviewed it.

## Data

- [All assessed works](api/works.json): one record per selected work, with the full structured assessment
- [All editions](api/editions.json): funnel counts, selections and the shortlist that was not selected
- [Atom feed](feed.xml)

## Standing pages

- [Charter](charter/): purpose and policies
- [Method](method/): sources, rating terms, criteria for concerns, licensing, conflicts
- [Corrections](corrections/)
